title: Echo
notes: Echo's router, template renderer (html/template) and JSON helper, with its recover middleware, served by net/http.
details: Echo's router, its renderer (echo.TemplateRenderer and c.Render, which is Go's html/template and does the escaping; Echo renders into a buffer before it sends) and c.JSON. The middleware is that of Echo's own example apart from the request logger: Recover. Served by net/http's server with the Echo instance as its handler, which Echo documents beside e.Start; e.Start's own shutdown handling on signals is therefore not there. One process on the default Go scheduler (GOMAXPROCS is every core), built with go build and no flags beyond -mod=readonly. Go has no build-time prerendering, so /about is a template with no data, rendered on each request like the item page; the templates are parsed once when the server starts. No request logging.
